definitions.explanation: a portable electronic device that automatically diagnoses cardiac arrhythmias and can deliver an electric shock to restore normal heart rhythm; widely installed in public places in Japan

examples.japanese: AED⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please confirm the location of the AED.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧AED⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: AEDs are installed at train stations.

examples.japanese: AED⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使|つか}い{方|かた}→使い方：07797_tsukaikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{習|なら}った→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: I learned how to use an AED in training.

notes:
EMERGENCY VOCABULARY:
AEDs (エーイーディー) are widely available in Japan at train stations, shopping centers, schools, sports facilities, and other public places. They are designed to be used by anyone, even without medical training.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- AED⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ - to use an AED
- AED⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧ - AED is installed
- AED⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧ - location of the AED
- AED{講習|こうしゅう} - AED training

RELATED WORDS:
- CPR / ⟦{心肺|しんぱい}{蘇生|そせい}→心肺蘇生：29912_shinpaisosei⟧⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧ - cardiopulmonary resuscitation
- ⟦{救急|きゅうきゅう}→救急：15075_kyuukyuu⟧⟦{処置|しょち}→処置：05823_shochi⟧ - emergency treatment
- ⟦{心停止|しんていし}→心停止：24762_shinteishi⟧ - cardiac arrest

USAGE:
Japanese AEDs provide voice guidance in Japanese. The device analyzes the heart rhythm and only delivers a shock if needed.
